# `rescheduleAppointment`

**Kind:** function tool — a question Grace waits on
**Source model:** `grace_contracts.tools.write_tools.RescheduleAppointmentInput`
**Generated JSON:** `platform/vapi/tools/rescheduleAppointment.json`

## What it does, and when Grace calls it

Move an existing appointment Grace can see. The tool decides whether a change fee applies — you never do, and you never waive one. State any fee it returns in full BEFORE confirming, and set feeAcknowledged only after the caller clearly agrees. If it can't find the appointment, don't insist — take a message for the front desk instead.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type / allowed values | Required | Default | What it means |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `bookingRef` | `string`, pattern `^[Bb][Kk]-[0-9A-Za-z]{4,8}$` | **yes** | — | Booking reference exactly as it was given to you, e.g. bk-3QR9. |
| `feeAcknowledged` | `boolean` | no | `false` | Set true only after you have stated the change fee and the caller agreed. Never assume agreement. |
| `newDate` | `string`, pattern `^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$` | **yes** | — | Local date in YYYY-MM-DD. Today or later. Never guess a year the caller did not say. |
| `newTimePreference` | `morning` · `afternoon` · `evening` · `any` | no | `"any"` | Rough time of day they want instead. Use 'any' if they did not say. |

Any parameter not listed above is **rejected**, not ignored — the model inventing a field must be a loud error, never silent.

## Settings

| Setting | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Runs in background | no | Grace waits for the answer before speaking |
| Changes data | **yes** | Must be idempotent on `callId:toolCallId` (I3) |
| p95 target | 700 ms | A target for alerting, **not** a deadline — the deadline is `GRACE_TOOL_DEADLINE_MS` |
| Request timeout | 10 s | Above our own deadline, so our graceful sentence fires first |
| Retry | **none** | A retried write is a real duplicate — a second booking, a second text |
| Live Vapi ID | `d081c164-5010-48c7-836e-cf123d5a13e1` | Vapi dashboard → **Tools** |

- **If it fails:** "I'm having trouble changing that appointment."
